title: S0 report
question: Can D1's claim model and schema and guideline v0 express what the core units state, and how determinate is annotation and adjudication?
method: Report rendered from the evidence catalog (ADR-0010): figures are queries over the S0 records' outputs; prose by the root.
conclusion: The claim model fits with a few constructs missing; annotators agree on content (core 0.93) far more than on qualifiers (full 0.63), which locates the work in guideline rules; adjudication is not yet determinate; Opus outperforms Haiku as annotator; the packet loses nothing at a fixed model; two key rules and two scope rules to change.
